title: Pal Dot Dance
style: Alternative R&B and dembow with a fast nightcore bounce, syncopated tablas, pulsing synth stabs, and a sweaty handclap groove; verse rides tight and playful, pre-chorus lifts with filtered vocal stacks and rising percussion, chorus hits with gang chants and higher harmonies. High lead vocal with doubled hooks, pitched ad-libs, and quick delay throws on the phrase ends. Ear candy: reversed claps before drops, tabla fills between lines, synth fizz into each chorus. Bright, punchy, and glossy, latin, rap, alternative r&b
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
clap and rap, clap and rap
you got that?
rap pal dot app
say it back

sing it back, pal
wanna dance, pal
dance, latin america pal
move that

high in the room
like, “hey, come through”
kid computer voices
talking to you

[Pre-Chorus]
pal, pal, closer now
spin around, don’t slow down
sing pal dot a i
reach for the sound

newwave in my chest
tablas on repeat
every little name
turns into a beat

sing pal, sing here
